example_en: She went to her parents' house for the festival.

definition: to enclose (a body of troops, a fort or town, etc.) so as to cut off communication or retreat; to surround.
example: ಸೈನ್ಯವು ಕೋಟೆಯನ್ನು ವೆಂಟಣಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚಿತು.
example_en: The army surrounded the fort and closed off all routes.

definition: lack of tolerance, liberality; the prejudiced, bigoted mind; meanness.
example_en: His narrow-mindedness did not accept others' opinions.

definition: that which is said aptly and precisely; a fine speech.
example_en: Every fine saying of that scholar was meaningful.

definition: any man or boy lacking normal function of the testes; an eunuch.
example_en: That eunuch was the guard of the palace.

definition: a very great quantity, usu. considered to be more than enough; abundance; excessiveness.
example_en: There was an abundance of sweets in the house.

definition: to become suitable for some purpose or be brought to the required temperment.
example_en: The jaggery syrup became suitable for the dish.

definition: that which covers, hides envelops something.
example: ದಪ್ಪ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಕೆ ಆ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The thick cover completely hid that box.

definition: a kind of game played with playing cards.
example_en: The children sat playing a card game in the evening.

definition: the state of half-cooked or half-baked.
example_en: That plan still shows a state of half-bakedness.

definition: the side of a human being between the ribs and hip; the flank.
example_en: His flank was hurt and it caused pain.

definition: a wide, metal plate.
example_en: The cook served the rice on a wide metal plate.

definition: a broad piece of armor, carried as a defence against swords, lances, arrows, etc.; a shield.
example_en: The soldier held a shield to protect himself from arrows.

definition: to cause to suck or chew.
example_en: The nurse made the patient suck on the medicine.

definition: wealth; riches.
example_en: That merchant has a lot of wealth.

definition: during of the divisions of the day (as day, night, morning, evening etc.).
example_en: He used to pray during that period of the day.

definition: awakened; intelligent; clever; wise.
example: ಆ ಬುಧ ಗುರುವಿನ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಬೇಗನೆ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That wise, intelligent man quickly grasped the teacher's words.
